material_type.evidence: E. coli cell pellets (200 μl) were mixed with 800 μl of UA20 buffer (6 M urea in 80% MS-grade water and 20% acetonitrile [ACN]), supplemented with protease inhibitors (Sigma–Aldrich; catalog no.: 04693124001) and subjected to cell lysis and homogenization using a probe sonicator (Sonifier, Branson) for three cycles of 30 s on 30% power, 50% duty cycle, and 30 s cooling on ice.

strain.evidence: The reference E. coli K-12 MG1655 was downloaded from UniProt (UP000000625, May 2024, 4402 entries) and used as the main database for this entire study.
